title: Skill Sprint: scaffold dev-gated page (single textbox)
description: Create the thinnest possible Skill Sprint page under the existing /dev gate: one textbox and minimal local state. This is pure scaffolding to anchor future work; no chat system, artifacts UI, or provider wiring implied.
acceptance: A dev-gated page exists for Skill Sprint and renders for dev-enabled users (non-dev users see 404 via existing /dev gate)
Page includes a large textbox suitable for describing what the user wants to get good at
Typed text is held in local state and survives basic UI interactions on the page (no persistence requirement yet)
notes: Keep it boring: a single page with a textbox. Any UX beyond that belongs in later tasks once the data model + provider seam are nailed down.

title: Skill Sprint: add Convex schema (5 tables)
description: Add skillSprints, skillSprintPlans, skillSprintAdjustments, skillSprintLessons, skillSprintJournalEntries tables to Convex schema with appropriate indexes.
acceptance: Tables defined in src/convex/schema.ts with correct field types
Indexes support: sprints by user, plans/adjustments/challenges/entries by sprintId, challenges unique by sprintId+dayKey
notes: Tables: skillSprints (userAuthId, title, goal, startsAt, endsAt, archivedAt, createdAt), skillSprintPlans (sprintId, md, version, updatedAt), skillSprintAdjustments (sprintId, createdAt, md), skillSprintLessons (sprintId, dayKey, generatedAt, planVersion, items[{id, title, detailsMd?, completedAt?}]), skillSprintJournalEntries (sprintId, dayKey?, createdAt, md). Plan: overwrite + version. Adjustments/journal: append-only.

title: Skill Sprint: implement persistence layer (mutations + queries)
description: Add Convex functions to create/read/update Skill Sprint data: createSprint, setPlan, addAdjustment, upsertDailyChallenge, addJournalEntry, plus basic queries.
acceptance: Mutations enforce ownership (userAuthId check)
setPlan increments version on each call
upsertDailyChallenge enforces one challenge per sprint+dayKey
Queries return data for a single sprint
deps: Skill Sprint: add Convex schema (5 tables)
notes: Day-boundary logic: duplicate UTC window from planner for now (see 'Extract day-boundary utility' task in root tasks.json for future cleanup).

title: Skill Sprint: LLM provider seam + prompt contract
description: Introduce a small, testable boundary for LLM calls used by Skill Sprint, including a stable prompt contract that always includes the artifacts (plan/feedback/progress) plus any selected key files/context.
acceptance: Provider seam defined (inputs/outputs, streaming vs non-streaming decision explicit)
Prompt contract defined (what artifacts are included and how they're summarized)
Stub/fake implementation strategy defined for local iteration without real provider calls
notes: Decision: provider seam is a Convex action that takes a caller-formatted message string + provider/model selection + credential source (app env var vs user setting). Seam responsibility ends at returning provider text (no prompt formatting / artifact packaging inside seam). Non-streaming v1; add follow-up task for streaming. User/provider settings stored under users.settingOverrides.llm; plaintext for closed alpha (encryption needs its own planning task: support E2E vs TLE modes, switchable in settings).

title: Skill Sprint: goal conversation + sprint creation (dev-gated)
description: Build the goal chat step with a portable chat component and a right-side goal statement. Create the sprint only when the user confirms the goal.
acceptance: Dev-gated route only (non-dev users see 404)
Chat renders on left, goal statement on right
<goal>...</goal> updates goalStatement
Confirm goal creates sprint and persists goalStatement
Portable chat component exists and goal UI wraps it
notes: Use the existing /dev gate; keep the chat component reusable for later Skill Sprint steps and other features.

title: Skill Sprint: planning session with assessment questions
description: Add planning step that starts with assessment questions and then a plan conversation. Confirm persists the plan artifact.
acceptance: Planning step starts with assessment questions
Assessment answers are captured and stored as part of the plan artifact
Plan conversation uses the portable chat component
Confirm plan persists plan record
deps: Skill Sprint: goal conversation + sprint creation (dev-gated)
notes: Assessment is temporary but should be stored as part of the plan artifact for now.

title: Skill Sprint: refactor lessons schema (sequential, not daily)
description: Restructure skillSprintLessons to be lesson-based rather than date-based. Rename dayKey to dateCreated, add status field, update all consuming code.
acceptance: dayKey renamed to dateCreated (timestamp) in schema and indexes
status field added: 'pending' | 'complete' | 'replaced'
Index updated to support queries by sprintId + dateCreated
Mutations and queries updated to use new field names
API layer types reflect new structure
deps: Skill Sprint: planning session with assessment questions
notes: This touches: schema.ts, skillSprints.ts, seam-interfaces.ts, ConvexSkillSprintProvider.ts. Lessons are sequential by creation time, not calendar-bound. Status tracks lifecycle: pending -> complete or pending -> replaced (when lesson regenerated after critique).

title: Skill Sprint: basic lesson view with checkboxes
description: Display the current lesson with interactive checkboxes. Show lesson items, allow completion toggling, display progress indicator. No navigation or generation yet.
acceptance: Lesson items render with checkboxes and titles
Checking/unchecking persists completedAt timestamp
Progress indicator shows X of Y complete
Completed items are visually dimmed but stay in place
If no lessons exist, show placeholder message
deps: Skill Sprint: refactor lessons schema (sequential, not daily)
notes: Displays the most recent incomplete lesson, or the latest lesson if all complete. Lesson sequence is implied by dateCreated sort order. No lesson generation logic in this task - that comes later.

title: Skill Sprint: interactive markdown elements for LLM output
description: Add LLM-injectable UI elements in markdown (e.g., <rating type="star">, <number type="time">) so the user can provide structured feedback on lesson items.
acceptance: Markdown renderer supports <rating> with configurable type (star, numeric, etc.)
Markdown renderer supports <number> with configurable type (time, distance, etc.)
User input from elements is captured in component state
Elements render with clear labels (from element content)
Graceful fallback when elements are absent or malformed
deps: Skill Sprint: basic lesson view with checkboxes
notes: Example: '<rating type="star">Difficulty</rating>' renders a 5-star picker labeled 'Difficulty'. '<number type="time">Duration</number>' renders a time input labeled 'Duration'. These serialize into lesson journal entries as: '## Challenge Title\nDifficulty: 4/5\nDuration: 10s'. Values stored in markdown format, parsed by future LLM calls for context.

title: Skill Sprint: lesson navigation UI
description: Add lesson selector to view past lessons and conditionally generate new ones. Users can navigate through completed lessons and trigger next lesson generation when current is complete.
acceptance: Lesson selector shows all lessons sorted by dateCreated (oldest first)
Selector displays lesson sequence number (implied from sort order)
'+' button appears only when viewing the latest lesson AND it is complete
Clicking '+' generates next lesson (calls generation logic)
Navigation works via dropdown or prev/next buttons
Current lesson is visually indicated in selector
deps: Skill Sprint: basic lesson view with checkboxes
notes: Lesson is 'complete' when all items have completedAt OR lesson status is 'complete'. The '+' button should be disabled/hidden if latest lesson is incomplete to prevent skipping ahead without engagement.

title: Skill Sprint: lesson journal & completion flow
description: Add journal entry textbox for lesson reflection/feedback. On submit, determine if feedback is plan critique (requires conversation) or progress reflection (auto-complete). Support lesson dismissal/skipping with guardrails.
acceptance: Journal textbox renders below lesson items
Submit sends journal content to LLM for classification (critique vs reflection)
If reflection: journal entry saved, lesson marked complete, next lesson can generate
If critique: conversation starts to understand plan adjustments (may result in lesson replacement)
'Skip to next lesson' button appears if at least 1 item completed OR user provides feedback
Skipping marks current lesson as 'replaced' and allows next generation
Feedback from interactive elements (<rating>, <number>) included in journal entry header
deps: Skill Sprint: interactive markdown elements for LLM output
notes:
Journal format: '# Lesson Answers
## [Item Title]
[interactive element responses]

# User Journal
[user text]'. Critique detection is LLM-based (simple prompt: does this indicate the lesson plan needs adjustment?). Replaced lessons stay in history for context but are visually marked as superseded.

title: Skill Sprint: auto-generate lessons
description: Implement lesson generation logic that auto-creates next lesson when appropriate. Checks for incomplete lessons on mount, generates if all complete, handles lesson replacement after critique.
acceptance: On daily phase mount, check for most recent lesson by dateCreated
If no lessons exist, auto-generate first lesson
If latest lesson is complete, do nothing (wait for user to click '+')
If latest lesson is 'replaced', auto-generate replacement
Generation creates new lesson record with status 'pending' and dateCreated timestamp
LLM prompt includes sprint goal, plan, and all journal entries for context
deps: Skill Sprint: refactor lessons schema (sequential, not daily)
notes: Generation is NOT automatic on completion - user must explicitly request next lesson via '+' button. Only auto-generates on mount if no valid lesson exists. Replacement lessons (after critique) ARE auto-generated after conversation resolves. This prevents overwhelming users with new content before they're ready.

title: Skill Sprint: data model + API updates (goalStatement + planning assessment)
description: Extend Convex schema and API to support goalStatement, planning assessment answers in plan artifact, and daily feedback storage.
acceptance: goalStatement stored on sprint
Assessment answers stored within the plan artifact
Daily feedback stored and queryable
Existing sprint data remains valid
deps: Skill Sprint: goal conversation + sprint creation (dev-gated)
notes: Ensure goalStatement is added to the sprint record and is used by the skills preview later.

title: Skill Sprint: restructure routes (selector + [sprintId] slug)
description: Refactor skill sprint routes to match projects pattern: base route shows sprint selector, [sprintId] slug shows specific sprint. Extract shared logic to /lib/API/SkillSprints/ for reusability.
acceptance: /skill-sprint/ shows list/selector of user's sprints
/skill-sprint/[sprintId]/ shows specific sprint with phase-based views (goal/planning/daily)
Data operations extracted to /lib/API/SkillSprints/ with reactive stores
Phase-specific workflow logic remains in route files
All existing functionality preserved
deps: Skill Sprint: planning session with assessment questions
notes: This task was completed. The daily lesson tasks are new additions that build on top of this restructured foundation. The /lib/API layer provides: getSprintState store, listUserSprints store, and mutation wrappers. Phase logic (goal conversation, planning assessment, daily challenges) stays route-specific since it's UX workflow, not reusable data operations.

title: Skill Sprint: persist conversation history per phase
description: Add conversation persistence so users don't lose chat history on page reload. Store conversations by sprint + phase (goal/planning/daily).
acceptance: New Convex table: skillSprintConversations with sprintId, phase, messages[], updatedAt
Messages persist on each send/receive
Conversations load on phase mount
Each phase has its own isolated conversation history
Old conversations remain accessible for context/debugging
deps: Skill Sprint: planning session with assessment questions
notes: Phase field should be enum: 'goal' | 'planning' | 'daily'. Messages array format: [{role: 'user'|'assistant'|'system', content: string, timestamp: number}]. Consider adding index by_sprintId_phase for efficient lookups. May want to cap message history or implement cleanup for very old sprints.
